sn47.47:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā …pe…
sn47.47:1.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn47.47:1.3: tasmā tiha tvaṃ bhikkhu ādimeva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu.
sn47.47:1.5: idha tvaṃ bhikkhu kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāvessasi
sn47.47:1.8: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāvessasi vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāvessasi manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāvessasi tato tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi.
sn47.47:2.2: idha tvaṃ bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi.
sn47.47:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.47:2.6: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāvessasi tato tuyhaṃ bhikkhu yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuḍḍhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti …pe…
sn47.47:2.7: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
